reasons: The clause was absent; a single concise insertion supplies every preferred element (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M tied to processing of Obligor information, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request) with no surplus wording.

Defined terms used (Servicer, Issuer, Depositor, Obligor, Agreement) are all resolved in the document, so no undefined term, contradiction or dangling mechanic is introduced and the untouched indemnity and charge provisions remain effective.
